env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^h1 circle r=3$'
stdout '^h2 square s=7$'
stdout '^bothkeys ambiguous$'
stdout '^unknown fails$'
stdout '^mixed selects local$'
stdout '^mixed bothkeys ambiguous$'
stdout '^differential ok$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/cross

go 1.27

-- w/a/a.lgo --
package a

type Circle struct {
  R int64 `json:"r"`
}

type Square struct {
  S int64 `json:"s"`
}

type Shape interface {
  Circle | Square
}

-- w/b/b.lgo --
package b

import "example.com/cross/a"

type Holder struct {
  Item a.Shape `json:"item"`
}

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
  "encoding/json"
  "fmt"

  "example.com/cross/a"
  "example.com/cross/b"
)

type Local struct {
  S int64 `json:"s"`
}

type Circle2 struct {
  R int64 `json:"r"`
}

type SingleShape interface {
  Circle2 | Local
}

type SingleHolder struct {
  Item SingleShape `json:"item"`
}

type MixedUnion interface {
  Local | a.Circle
}

type MixedHolder struct {
  Item MixedUnion `json:"item"`
}

func main() {
  var h b.Holder
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"r":3}}`), &h); err != nil {
    panic("h1 unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  c, ok := h.Item.(a.Circle)
  if !ok || c.R != 3 {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("h1 want a.Circle R=3 got %T %#v", h.Item, h.Item))
  }
  fmt.Println("h1 circle r=3")
  var h2 b.Holder
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"s":7}}`), &h2); err != nil {
    panic("h2 unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  sq, ok := h2.Item.(a.Square)
  if !ok || sq.S != 7 {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("h2 want a.Square S=7 got %T %#v", h2.Item, h2.Item))
  }
  fmt.Println("h2 square s=7")
  var hb b.Holder
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"r":1,"s":2}}`), &hb); err == nil {
    panic("bothkeys want error got nil")
  }
  fmt.Println("bothkeys ambiguous")
  var hu b.Holder
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"zzz":1}}`), &hu); err == nil {
    panic("unknown want error got nil")
  }
  var su SingleHolder
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"zzz":1}}`), &su); err == nil {
    panic("single unknown want error got nil")
  }
  fmt.Println("unknown fails")
  var m MixedHolder
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"s":9}}`), &m); err != nil {
    panic("mixed unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  if l, ok := m.Item.(Local); !ok || l.S != 9 {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("mixed want Local S=9 got %T %#v", m.Item, m.Item))
  }
  fmt.Println("mixed selects local")
  var mb MixedHolder
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"r":1,"s":2}}`), &mb); err == nil {
    panic("mixed bothkeys want error got nil")
  }
  fmt.Println("mixed bothkeys ambiguous")
  inputs := []string{`{"item":{"r":3}}`, `{"item":{"s":7}}`, `{"item":{"r":1,"s":2}}`, `{"item":{"zzz":1}}`, `{"item":{}}`}
  for _, in := range inputs {
    var sh SingleHolder
    var mh MixedHolder
    serr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(in), &sh)
    merr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(in), &mh)
    if (serr == nil) != (merr == nil) {
      panic(fmt.Sprintf("differential mismatch for %s single=%v mixed=%v", in, serr, merr))
    }
  }
  fmt.Println("differential ok")
}
